Mali.title: Counter-terrorism: IATTC and DIRPA train journalists to deconstruct extremist narratives
Mali.summary: The Islamic Military Coalition to Combat Terrorism (IMCTC), in collaboration with the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), closed this Friday, October 2, 2026, a training session devoted to the analysis of extremist and hate speech in digital media . From September 28 to October 2, 2026, media professionals as well as members of the Defense and Security Forces (FDS) took part in this session organized around the theme: “Analysis of Extremist Speech and Hate Speech in Digital Media: Tools and Techniques for Intelligent Confrontation” .

Mali.title: Fight against terrorism: Captain (Navy) Ibrahima Sow invites the media to collaborate more with DIRPA
Mali.summary: The Director of the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), Captain (Navy) Ibrahima Sow, recalled the role of the media in the prevention of hate speech and violent extremism, on the occasion of the closing of the training organized by the Islamic Military Coalition to Combat Terrorism (IMCT) . According to the Director of DIRPA, the IMCT is an alliance of 43 states with a common Muslim religion, which are committed to organizing against terrorism and violent extremism in their regions .

Mali.title: Supply: A convoy of 643 tanker trucks arrives in Bamako under military escort
Mali.summary: A large convoy of more than 643 tanker trucks entered the Malian capital this Saturday, October 3, 2026, at around 7 a.m., after a night escort provided by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) . The convoy advanced all night under the protection of the military, kilometer after kilometer, before reaching Bamako at dawn. This operation is part of the continuous strengthening of the supply of petroleum products on the national territory .

Mali.title: Mali: Arrival in Bamako of an exceptional convoy of more than 643 tankers under military escort
Mali.summary: While Bamako slept, a long column of tankers advanced into the night, under the watchful protection of our valiant Malian Armed Forces (FAMa). Kilometre after kilometre, our soldiers watched over each vehicle. This Saturday, October 3, 2026, around 7 a.m., at daybreak, more than 643 tankers entered the capital.

Mali.title: Mali: more than 2,400 schools remain closed as insecurity disrupts new school year
Mali.summary: Mali's new school year began Thursday with more than 2,400 schools unable to reopen, as worsening insecurity and the growing presence of jihadist groups continue to disrupt education. The 2026-2027 academic year has been declared the “Year of Education and Culture” by President Assimi Goïta, but thousands of children are starting the year without access to their classrooms.

Burkina Faso.title: Government exhibition The minister in charge of war, Célestin Simporé, exchanges with citizens
Burkina Faso.summary: The Minister of State, Minister of War and Patriotic Defence, Major General Célestin Simporé, moderated the first session of the "Dialogue with the People" on the theme "Governance, National Security: The Standing People Account to You", Friday, October 2, 2026, at the SIAO . The Minister of War and Patriotic Defence, Major General Célestin Simporé lent himself to an exercise of government accountability to the people on Friday, October 2, 2026 at the SIAO .

Burkina Faso.title: Gourma/Security: 600 national VDPs complete their training to strengthen the security of the region - 'Agence d 'Information du Burkina (AIB)
Burkina Faso.summary: Gourma/Security: 600 national VDPs complete their training to strengthen the security of the region 'Burkina Information Agency (AIB)

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso's military leaders mark four years in power
Burkina Faso.summary: People gathered in Ougadougou’s Place de la Révolution on Wednesday night to mark four years since Captain Ibrahim Traoré came to power in a coup. The culmination of anniversary celebrations, they paid tribute to the armed forces and the military government’s achievements in Burkina Faso. One resident, Abdoul Rasmané Sawadogo, said military leaders have created an “ultra-modern army that meets expectations”.

Burkina Faso.title: Pix of the Day, 30 September, 2026 - Across the world
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso has inaugurated its first gold refinery as its military-led government seeks to strengthen economic sovereignty after breaking ties with its traditional Western partners. “From now on, Burkina Faso’s gold must not only be mined in Burkina Faso; it must also be processed, controlled, valued and certified there,” President Ibrahim Traoré said on Monday at the inauguration of the refinery, named Raffinor-BF.

Burkina Faso.title: Crash of the Ouagadougou-Alger flight: Swiftair condemned
Burkina Faso.summary: The families of the victims had to wait twelve years. Gathered within the association "AH-5017 Ensemble", they led a "relentless fight for truth and justice" which is now experiencing its judicial outcome. The Spanish company Swiftair is found guilty of manslaughter this Monday morning by the Paris Criminal Court .

Niger.title: Algeria sent fighter jets to Niger to thwart ‘coup attempt’, president says
Niger.summary: Algeria’s President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has said that his country sent fighter jets to Niger in late August to help thwart a “coup attempt” that shook the capital, Niamey. The confirmation came in excerpts from Tebboune’s interview with local media outlets that was broadcast on Saturday ahead of its full release.

Niger.title: Algeria's president reveals behind the scenes of sending fighter jets to thwart coup attempt in Niger
Niger.summary: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune revealed that his country sent fighter jets to Niger at the end of last August to thwart a coup attempt, stressing that his country's military move came in response to "provocations" to Algeria. In excerpts from an interview Tebboune gave to local media, the Algerian president explained that his Nigerian counterpart Mohamed Lamine Zine was on a visit to the country, and returned at night to his country, before a coup attempt took place.

Niger.title: Coup in Niger: Algeria denounces a "provocation" and reveals its military intervention
Niger.summary: Coup d 'état in Niger: Algeria denounces a "provocation" and reveals its military intervention The Algerian President, Abdelmadjid Tebboune, strongly reaffirmed his country's unconditional support for Niger. During his regular meeting with the national press, the Head of State unveiled unprecedented details on Algiers' reaction to the recent coup attempt, described as an act of major destabilization .

Niger.title: Niger: several soldiers fallen at the front and dozens of "mercenaries" neutralized in a new terrorist attack towards Abala
Niger.summary: Several Nigerien soldiers fell on the battlefield and others were wounded in a new terrorist attack on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, in the Fartal area, located 22 km east of Abala, in the Tillabéri region, announced the Minister of National Defence in a statement issued in the evening According to the same source, violent clashes took place between Nigerien soldiers, in an operation to intercept a convoy of cattle stolen the day before in the area, and a large column of "motorcycle mercenaries" and "heavily armed" .

Niger.title: Defence: General Tiani reshuffles the military command after the Niamey mutiny
Niger.summary: Defense: General Tiani reshuffles the military command after the Niamey mutiny Published on Saturday, September 12, 2026 | actuniger.com Two weeks to the day after the Niamey mutiny, the President of the Republic and Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces, General Abdourahamane Tiani, Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces, reshuffled the head of the Niger army on Friday, September 11, 2026 According to a statement from the Ministry of National Defence read in the evening on public television, the post of Chief of the Armed Forces Staff (CEMA), Major General Moussa Salaou Barmou, a member of the CNSP and in office since…

Niger.title: Niger: 16 soldiers killed at the front and 15 terrorists neutralized in a terrorist ambush between Bankilaré and Tera (Tillabéri)
Niger.summary: Niger region: 16 soldiers fallen at the front and 15 terrorists neutralized in a terrorist ambush between Bankilaré and Tera (Tillabéri) Published on Tuesday, July 21, 2026 | actuniger.com

Niger.title: Niger: what we know about the jihadist attack that targeted Niamey airport
Niger.summary: Niger: what we know about the jihadist attack that targeted the Niamey airport Published on Saturday, January 31, 2026 | AFP In the night from Wednesday to Thursday, the Niamey airport in Niger suffered a brief attack claimed Friday by the Islamic State, in a country where jihadist violence usually occurs in the west and south-east The Nigerien military junta, helped by "Russian partners", accused the French, Beninese and Ivorian presidents of being the "sponsors" of the attackers, words condemned by Abidjan and Cotonou on Friday.

Niger.title: Niger: Islamic State claims responsibility for attack on Niamey airport
Niger.summary: Published on Friday, January 30, 2026 | AFP The Islamic State claimed responsibility on Friday for the attack on Niamey airport in Niger, said the Site group, which specializes in counter-terrorism research . On the night of Wednesday to Thursday, Niamey airport, which is home to military sites and is about ten kilometers from the presidency, was the target of an attack leaving 20 dead on the attacking side, according to the Nigerien military junta .

Niger.title: Drug trafficking: two young people in their twenties arrested with 12,000 Tramadol tablets at the Tillabéri road barrier
Niger.summary: Published on Tuesday, December 30, 2025 | actuniger.com The vigilance of the security forces has once again borne fruit . On December 22, 2025, officers of the Yantala Police Station seized 12,000 Tramadol tablets during a routine check at the Tillabéri road barrier, thwarting an attempt to transport drugs to a gold site in the region, with the arrest of two young Nigeriens in their twenties .

Niger.title: Agadez: the SDF repulse an attack in Abalama  two bandits neutralized, equipment seized, one soldier killed and four wounded
Niger.summary: Agadez: SDF repels attack in Abalama – two bandits neutralized, equipment seized, one soldier killed and four wounded Published on Friday, September 5, 2025 | actuniger.com On Tuesday, September 2, 2025, the Defense and Security Forces (SDF) successfully repulsed two simultaneous attacks targeting the positions of the National Guard detachment in Abalama, Aderbissanat Department .
